text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower was set to do a live stream on UmaTube together with Mayano Top Gun, and I was there to watch over them as her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone~
As promised, we have a guest today~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm Nishino Flower.
I look forward to working with you today!

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text: "It's Flower-chan! She's so cute~!"

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text: "Go for it~!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Everyone looks so~ happy
that Flower-chan came!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible.
So many people are here...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Then let's get started right away~!
Today, Maya and the others will be reading
comments sent in by our fans in advance!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
First up is... from Shishamo Dandelion-san!
"I recently messed up at work and it's been really tough.
Could you cheer me up if you don't mind?" it says!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Eye copy! Maya's gonna cheer on Shishamo Tanpopo-san with all her might!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hoo-ray! Hoo-ray! Shishamo Tanpopo-san!
Keep your chin up and take oooff!
Maya will always be cheering you on!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
All right! Next, Flower-chan,
you cheer for Shishamo Tanpopo-san too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh!? U-Um...! Shishamo-Dandelion-san, thank you for your hard work as always!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I don't know what kind of job you do, Shishamo Dandelion-san, or what kind of mistake you made, but—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I've heard that failure only happens
because someone was willing to take on a challenge.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So... I'm sure Shishamo Tanpopo-san
was giving her absolute best to take on a challenge too, right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Just from that alone...
I respect Shishamo Tanpopo-san so much
for being such a hard worker!

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text: “The Holy Mother... The Holy Mother is here...”

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like crying...
It's warming my heart, too..."

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text: "I want to be cheered up too...!"

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text: "Goo goo gaa gaa."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Flower-chan, you're amazing...!
Everyone in the comments is moved in a way I've never seen before...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, even as the chat went wild over
Nishino Flower's antics, the livestream proceeded smoothly—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer...!
How was the stream with Mayano-san?
Was there anything weird about it...?
choice_data_list: Everyone was really happy with it.
I felt like I wanted Flower to cheer me up, too.
I found myself wanting you to encourage me too, Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer...!
How was the stream with Mayano-san?
Was there anything weird about it...?
choice_data_list: Everyone was really happy with it.
I felt like I wanted Flower to cheer me up, too.
I found myself wanting you to encourage me too, Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so?
In that case, I'm glad!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Um, I've been thinking,
if that's what everyone wants, should I start doing
livestreams on my own?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I thought maybe I could bring some joy to people by cheering them on, but...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering how heated the comments are today,
letting Nishino Flower stream all by herself
might turn into a disaster...!
choice_data_list: Showing them your run is the best encouragement of all.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "...You're so right! I'll move everyone's hearts with my running...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Later on, the stream archive of Nishino Flower and Mayano Top Gun became a sanctuary of sorts for those seeking encouragement—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
E-Eh!?
Y-You too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I'll do my absolute best... to cheer them on.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're always working so hard.
I have so much respect for the wonderful adult you are!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to your hard work, Trainer,
I can do my best too.
So—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'll give you a big gold star!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The immense warmth radiating from Nishino Flower nearly overwhelmed my heart—
